_instructions: One object per alert event. Copy the _blank_record. Fill ONLY what is directly visible; use "UNKNOWN" (never guess). Times in the chart's displayed timezone AND UTC where possible. This is an observation log, NOT a trade signal.

_field_guidance.broker_feed: Pepperstone (confirm the header reads Pepperstone; if a different feed, record it verbatim)
_field_guidance.chart_timezone: read from the TradingView clock bottom-right (e.g. 'UTC+1'); record verbatim
_field_guidance.candle_open_time / candle_close_time: the signal bar's open & close (chart TZ + UTC)
_field_guidance.alert_arrival_time: wall-clock the toast/app notification arrived (UTC + chart TZ); compare to candle_close_time
_field_guidance.condition: one of: A+++ setup | A+ or better | Any alert() function call | Sweep low | Sweep high | CHoCH up | CHoCH down
_field_guidance.exact_message: the LITERAL alert message text as delivered (copy verbatim; note if plain name / JSON / other)
_field_guidance.visible_direction: bullish | bearish | none | UNKNOWN (as shown by the marker/label)
_field_guidance.visible_price: price at/associated with the event (from chart/panel)
_field_guidance.grade: A+++ | A+ | none-shown | UNKNOWN (what the panel/label displays at that bar)
_field_guidance.panel_values: capture TF / CHoCH / Asia break / OB retest / Current OB / Fresh OB verbatim
_field_guidance.objects_*: note the relevant OB / FVG / BPR / sweep / CHoCH object present (price/label) or 'none'
_field_guidance.persist_after_1_candle: still present & unchanged 1 bar later? yes | changed | removed | UNKNOWN
_field_guidance.persist_after_5_candles: still present & unchanged 5 bars later? yes | changed | removed | UNKNOWN
_field_guidance.any_alert_matched_named: if condition=Any alert(): which named condition (if any) it corresponds to, or 'no-match' | n/a
